title: plan 10 and everything since: the independent review of 2026-11-22
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code or by a run in a private worktree with planted inputs; no model, Docker stack or whole suite was run. The page gives the exact input of each.

findings.claim: Seven release criteria (11, 23, 25, 33, 35, 38, 39) pass only through cards D-1068 does not schedule (10G-50, 10E-20, 9j-7, 9l-1, 10D-24, 10E-18, 9l-15, 10K-12)
The bench record's 13.8 % lost-eligible figure names no verifier, prompt, rule or scorer and is not reproduced by the tree's stored answers (17.4 %); the 11-08 record's 9.4 % is a projection
Two different 5 % limits are in force (D-343 and D-918: point estimate on 400 pairs; plan criterion 1: 95 % upper bound on 124 gold-eligible pairs) and the bench record calls it the gate 5 limit
tools/trec_ct_eval.py:360 counts an unanswered criterion as not blocking, so a model that fails to answer scores the best lost-eligible rate

The ratchet and gate scanners stop listed spellings only: SQL built by joining strings, an error decided by a process's error text, a model path split across a plus sign and a bare suppression comment pass on master; 5 of 5 and 8 of 10 bypasses pass on the gate 2 and gate 5 drafts
On the gate drafts #1294 and #1295 four planted mistakes stay green: national-identifier conflict check removed, source namespace dropped from the record key, a partly masked name, a dropped refusal
The rule against model names in docs and code comments is not met by the tree (235 files under docs/, 60 under eval/) and no scan checks it

The findings register is stale: 63 High open, none seen closed, no row newer than 2026-11-19, none of the High findings of the independent reviews since; --check verifies form only and --release is not in CI
The decisions index has no superseded state; replaced decisions (D-526, D-63, D-104) still read merged and are still cited in code
services/matching/decision.py:110: no test fails when a single-model note answer is allowed to exclude (568 tests green under the planted mistake)
47 strict expected-failure marks keep known High defects green with no expiry; one non-strict case yields 168 passes that cannot fail

tests/console/test_prefs_10f1.py sends about 197,000 requests and its seven role cases always land in unit shard 1 (1,304 s of a 40-minute limit); one file per role spreads them over five shards without weakening
Every scheduled nightly since 2026-11-10 is red (12 of 12 and 11 of 11); mutation score 59.2 % under its floor of 60; tests/unit/test_access_log_route.py is order dependent (seed 3529504414)
tools/ci_docs_only.py treats any Markdown file as a document, so a card changing only the shipped prompt services/edc/prompts/crf_prefill_v1.md runs no test
The screenshot job passes a page master could not draw as not compared, so a real change to that page is not judged on that run

The D-985 guard (a negated, family-history, rule-out or suspected quote never excludes) is applied only in services/matching/cascade/engine.py:1232; the v1 evaluator used by the re-check, navigation and single-case scenarios excludes on such a quote when both models agree
An inclusion answered not met from notes excludes on any verified quote, even one that says nothing about the criterion, on both evaluation paths

Compiler post-processing leaves wrong populations unflagged: a pregnancy-test inclusion stays sex = female; a Japanese HIV-negative line stays has HIV; refrained-from and off-drug lines run as presence; a qualified mixed exclusion runs on any code

On #1301 a ruleset released by labelled demonstration approvals is refused outside DEV and TEST only where it is compiled, not where it is published or loaded; no person's approval is read by the compile yet
The judge is not given the trial's index condition and arm headings are not parsed; both were named as causes by the project's audit of 2026-11-05 and are not built
libs/tb_common/logging.py:152 and :217: log extra values that are not text (objects, paths, exceptions, bytes, integers) are written unscrubbed
A log formatter exception (a tuple key in the extras) prints the raw log arguments to the error stream

The masker and the tripwire release names without a label and names behind encodings (percent, entities, zero-width joiner, decomposed macron); 16 of 76 probes missed, Japanese 8 of 30; site criterion F3 is not met

On #1314 at head 04ef4222 a pseudonym still leaves a built support bundle inside base64 JSON, across the 64 MB read cut taken before the scrub, across a quoted-printable break, beside an encoded digit and across a zero-width joiner
On master the support bundle masks no pseudonym at all (tools/support_bundle.py:295)
Bulk import from two sources merges two patients' record with the same id into one; this path is outside gate 2's first slice
services/guard/guard.py:56: the gateway's tripwire and the trace store lose the site's chart-number rule without a word when settings cannot be read
Mail decides whether a message carries patient data from the caller's tag and never scans the body (services/mail_gateway/outbound.py:226)
The guard test sets draw their surnames from the recogniser's own list
Successive small-cell-suppressed opportunity feeds can be differenced across periods

The nightly backup fails every night on a stock box: the scheduled job runs the host interpreter with no library path and tools/trialbox/restic_repo.py:34 imports tb_common (install finding F-32, fix only on #1302)
The restore drill and restore cannot run as the runbook types them (install finding F-33)
A box whose key is sealed to its security chip passes the health check and go-live with no escrow recorded; restore onto new hardware then fails
None of the six refusals rc1 promises outside DEV and TEST exists on master; a validation box behaves as production; the only switch refuses uploads and pasted chart text
The orchestrator authorises a job by the role's best case, ignores the study's standing and scope and does not ask again when the job runs; the matrix tests do not see the check removed
Removing the unsigned tail of the audit chain together with the head file leaves only a note; verification passes and the nightly signer signs the shortened chain
The legacy shared service token is still accepted on master: #1267 shows merged and was reverted on the train (429b93a0)
The key passphrase still reaches the process list or disk (install finding F-17)
Every service that needs one site key mounts and can open all of them
The console's command line opens protected accounts outside the two-person rule
The scheduled night never passes since (services/orchestrator/scheduler.py:438), so every night re-reads the whole storage; card 10B-11 is not built and site criterion F8's delta night does not exist
services/adapter/sources/ssmix2/source.py:1133: the SS-MIX2 reader's snapshot grouping is quadratic in patients (12.7 s at 4,000, 47.6 s at 8,000); every CI scale job uses CSV input
services/adapter/app.py:146 and services/lake/app.py:284 record no reason when a night process is killed by a signal (the likely cause of install finding F-44)
A truncated or half-written SS-MIX2 file is read as complete: a wrong drug code stored as active, or an order or diagnosis that vanishes for the night

A first load of 50,000 patients and five studies does not fit three nights as shipped: the screening run exceeds the orchestrator's memory cap and the 2,000-patient night allowance is shared by all studies
Two delta tests cannot fail for the reason they are named for and their full-rebuild reference starts from the first night's lake; a cancelled discharge differs between delta and rebuild
The install test's findings F-5 to F-45 are not in the findings register; 2 of 41 are fixed on master
44 of 71 host commands on the runbook's pages fail on a bare host as written, among them backup key generation, restore, the restore drill, the health check and the key unseal
The runbook tests check the scheduled backup line as text and run runbook commands in the developer's interpreter; 5 of 8 planted mistakes in install, backup and runbook code survive
The first-run wizard's Japan defaults (10K-1) are built but off by default; the counted set-up follow (10K-17) has no commit
The move from the previous release to the new one is not tested with a real older release; the change log describes an update from a stick that is not on master
On an exclusion criterion the Japanese and Traditional Chinese lines for the two model checks read as absent when the check found the exclusion present (week.html:80, _criteria.html:25)
The Japanese word for unknown says no record even where a quote is shown; Traditional Chinese uses two words on one page; unknown never excludes is not said on the week page

The text checker never compares Japanese or Traditional Chinese with English: a deleted key, a wrong placeholder (error 500 on the Japanese page), a Simplified character and swapped verdict words all pass
Journey cards J-3, J-5, J-6 and J-7 are merged with their switches off and walked with them off; the shared page header is used by 4 of 111 templates
Core words differ from their own list in Japanese; a deviation sentence drops before; quotes carry no language attribute in 8 of 9 places; the printed user guide is English only

A docs-only pull request that adds a page under docs/reviews/ runs two property tests that need the report fonts in the cross-card job, which fetches none: 277 errors on this page's own pull request (job 137168755036)
services/deliverables (the feasibility pack, a specification deliverable) is reached by no service; a feasibility job never builds it
One import cycle through 15 service packages and 296 cross-service imports (280 five days earlier); there is no architecture test
22 of 28 database schemas are reached by two or more service roles, 17 by both the console and the orchestrator; the boundary between them does not bind the data
Configuration grows without a ratchet: 533 declared settings (366 on 2026-11-12), 321 direct reads of the environment; site_params.yaml has no reader
27 erasure entries are owed, about six of them for copies of data the default screening path never reads (the FHIR store, the OMOP history, the second vector store)
tools/ (about 133,000 lines) is in every product container and imported by the console; the operations tool inside it runs on the host interpreter, where it fails
The largest functions keep growing with no ratchet: the console's create_app 2,020 to 2,243 lines and the adapter's _run_ingest 660 to 724 in five days
Four identifier maskers give different results on one input: mrn=70000054 survives three of four
services/lake/textproc.py:32: the lake's chunker cuts inside a value (BP 120/80); the other chunker does not
Two modules each call themselves the only entry to the model; three callers use the lower one and skip the schema check and retry of the upper
